docker_username.description: Docker Hub username used to authenticate the optional Personal Access Token. Lowercase alphanumerics, underscores, and hyphens only.

namespace.description: Docker Hub user or organization namespace targeted by repository, tag, and connection-check requests. Required separately from docker_username so a requested target namespace is never silently replaced by the authentication identity. Lowercase alphanumerics, underscores, and hyphens only.

repository.description: Repository name (without the namespace prefix) the 'tags'/'repository_detail'/'tag_detail' streams are scoped to. Required only when reading one of those streams.

tag.description: Tag name the 'tag_detail' stream reads a single tag record for (e.g. 'latest'). Required only when reading the 'tag_detail' stream.

base_url.description: Docker Hub registry API base URL override for tests or self-hosted proxies.

auth_url.description: Docker Hub authentication API base URL. It is intentionally independent of base_url so a data API proxy cannot receive Docker Hub credential-exchange requests; override only for a trusted HTTPS test or self-hosted authentication proxy.

page_size.description: Page size (1-100) for the initial request of each paginated stream (Docker Hub's page_size query param); subsequent pages follow the API's own absolute next URL verbatim.

tier.description: Docker Registry subscription class used only by the provider-cited pull-rate policy. Use paid for Pro, Team, Business, or partner/unlimited Registry access; Hub API abuse limits are not inferred from this field.

auth_type.description: Docker Registry pull authentication profile used only by the provider-cited Registry rate-limit policy. This is intentionally separate from the optional Docker Hub API PAT/session hook.

registry_client_ip.description: Public IPv4 address or IPv6 /64 used to scope the unauthenticated Docker Registry pull quota. Required only when base_url targets registry-1.docker.io and auth_type is unauthenticated; never store a credential here.

docker_pat.description: Docker Hub Personal Access Token for docker_username. Optional: omitted, the connector stays read-only-public exactly as before (streams.json falls back to unauthenticated requests). When set, it authenticates every account-scoped, organization, group/team, invite, access-token, audit-log, and repository-write command by exchanging it for a short-lived session bearer token via Docker Hub's own POST /v2/users/login (never sent or logged as a static bearer value itself). Never printed, logged, or echoed by any command.

scim_bearer_token.description: A Docker Hub Enterprise SCIM API bearer token, distinct from docker_pat. Docker Hub's OpenAPI document declares SCIM (/v2/scim/2.0/**) under a separate bearerSCIMAuth security scheme from the rest of the API's bearerAuth; the two credentials are never interchangeable. Required only for the scim-users/scim-schemas/scim-resource-types commands; every other command is unaffected if this is omitted. Never printed, logged, or echoed by any command.
